title: BEYU OS — current main comprehensive architecture matrix

source.head: 8516162052a59ad7f538d78cfb7539fcb2f97c40
source.testEvidence: PARTIAL — PostgreSQL-dependent suites could not collect without DATABASE_URL

capabilities.blocker: Constitution, policy hierarchy and governance lifecycle primitives exist, but policy provenance/ratification and production DB evidence are unavailable.
users.id is the GlobalUserID and the graph is implemented, but users.party_id has no database uniqueness constraint and the live identity state was not available.
Read-only graph resolver exists and fails closed on duplicate users, but its database duplicate-prevention invariant is not durable.
One employees table, identity linkage, temporal reads and sector consumption exist; all employee lifecycle writes correctly remain authority-blocked.

capabilities.capability: Governance bodies, resolutions, voting and decisions
capabilities.blocker: Propose/table/vote/closure services exist, but seeded/reference rows are not ratified authority and live DB proofs were unavailable.
Fail-closed gate exists; all seeded decisions are intended to remain PENDING/LOCKED and authority ratification is absent from available evidence.
Effective-window evaluation exists, but the active seed policies have no approving resolution and are deliberately consumed pending the C-1 decision.
Runtime authorization reads ROLES in constants.ts while permissions/role_permissions are also persisted; parity is checked but the source-of-truth cutover is incomplete.
Capability dependencies and LOCKED defaults exist; no production capability may be activated without governed decisions and explicit activation.
Application predicates are widespread and RLS covers selected tables, but setDatabaseTenantContext uses pooled non-transactional session state; isolation was not live-tested.
Entity checks exist in core mutation paths, but most tenant/entity relationships are not composite database constraints and the live data was unavailable.

capabilities.capability: Finance OS financial truth and ledger
capabilities.blocker: Single posting writer, ledger schema, double-entry triggers and immutability exist; P1/P6/P7/P9 remain unratified and no posting is authorized.
Treasury schema and read-only specialists exist, but live positions, attribution findings and reconciliation state could not be fingerprinted.
Capital governance authorization is a non-executing transition; capital execution/funding remains absent and authority-blocked.
Tax intelligence distinguishes positions and blocks evasion; no authoritative liability/treatment is created and tax execution is not activated.
Legal matter/document storage exists; legal interpretation and binding legal conclusions are intentionally not implemented.
Finance epistemic classes and promotion guards exist, but not every UI/Noelia/dashboard output uses the canonical unavailable-value representation.
Hash chain and immutable triggers exist, but migration 0001 contains destructive TRUNCATE statements and audit metadata/hash coverage is not complete.
One append writer and hash chain exist; event/audit writes outside withAuditTransaction remain independently committed in simulation/tax routes.
Trace IDs exist across API responses and governed services, but AuditInput.traceId is optional and posting/logout paths can omit it.
Finance lineage is implemented and rejects derived canonical truth; universal enterprise reverse lineage is not evidenced.
One pure workflow primitive exists; persisted workflow_instances/tasks have no execution service and financial transitions require authority.
Single deterministic Noelia identity with audit/policy inheritance exists; no external LLM/tool execution or human-review disposition workflow exists.
MFA, session hashing and headers exist, but pooled RLS context, concurrent MFA replay, CSRF/origin defense and current dependency advisories remain unresolved/unverified.

capabilities.capability: Sector OS consumption beneath BEYU OS
capabilities.blocker: Sector registries and Foundation/Health consumption seams exist; no actual Sector OS implementation is present in this repository.

capabilities.capability: CI, deployment, backup and restore infrastructure
capabilities.blocker: Repository contains documentation/sample CI configuration, but no live database, deployment, role/permission evidence or restore evidence was available.
11 SQL migrations and 72 baseline tables are present; clean-install/upgrade parity and actual fingerprint could not be executed without PostgreSQL.
